description: This file declares functions related to the implementation of Multi-Head Attention (MHA) operations using cuDNN within the ATen/native namespace, including forward and backward functions for both standard and nested tensor inputs.

methods.name: run_cudnn_SDP_fprop
methods.description: Performs forward pass of scaled dot-product attention using cuDNN, for standard tensors.

methods.name: run_cudnn_SDP_fprop_nestedtensor
methods.description: Performs forward pass of scaled dot-product attention using cuDNN, for nested tensors.

methods.name: run_cudnn_SDP_bprop
methods.description: Performs backward pass (gradient calculation) for scaled dot-product attention for standard tensors.

methods.name: run_cudnn_SDP_bprop_nestedtensor
methods.description: Performs backward pass (gradient calculation) for scaled dot-product attention for nested tensors.
